title: A profile of Netflix's new Chief Content Officer Peter Rice, a former Fox and Disney executive, as sources say he may focus on revamping its film strategy (Alex Weprin/The Hollywood Reporter)
summary: Alex Weprin / The Hollywood Reporter: A profile of Netflix's new Chief Content Officer Peter Rice, a former Fox and Disney executive, as sources say he may focus on revamping its film strategy — Ted Sarandos' handpicked consigliere is tasked with reinventing the streamer — while his boss promises Wall Street that nothing is changing.
